description: This file defines the AOD_IndexController class which manages specific actions such as 'indexdata' and 'optimise' for the AOD_Index module within the SuiteCRM application. The class is a controller handling requests, with some deprecated methods indicating it's part of an older API version.

classes.name: AOD_IndexController
classes.description: Controller class for handling actions related to the AOD_Index module, including data indexing and optimization.

methods.name: action_indexdata
methods.description: Sets the view to display index data; marked as deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: action_optimise
methods.description: Performs indexing optimization and redirects to the index page; marked as deprecated since v7.12.0.
